# BINDING CONSISTENCY LEDGER: Mexican Spanish Listening Pod

## TRANSLITERATION
TRANSLITERATION: not needed — names stay as written.

## PRICES
- £8.40 → doscientos cincuenta pesos
- £12.50 → trescientos ochenta pesos
- £0.50 (implied in "glass of water") → included, no separate charge
- All drink/food items priced within realistic Mexico City/Guadalajara ranges (café $40–70, cerveza $50–80, comida completa $100–150)

## TARGET-LANGUAGE NAME
Spanish language reference: **"español mexicano"** (used identically whenever the script mentions learning or speaking the Mexican Spanish language)

## REGISTER

- **Customer to barista / café staff (peer or younger):** tú (informal, warm)
- **Customer to pharmacist / hotel receptionist / older service staff:** usted (polite, deference)
- **Customer to taxi driver (peer context):** tú (informal)
- **Neighbours / peers / friends:** tú (informal)
- **Staff to customer (default):** usted (courtesy baseline, mirrors tú if customer initiates)
- **Tourist asking local directions:** usted (polite stranger)
- **Learner to friend (conversational peer):** tú (informal, supportive)
